name: DreamEast Group Limited
summary: DreamEast Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the property development and leasing, tourism park operation, and other services businesses in the People's Republic of China. It also operates cultural tourist resorts and theme parks under the DreamEast brand; and provides movie and television culture services. The company was formerly known as SkyOcean International Holdings Limited and changed its name to DreamEast Group Limited in July 2017. DreamEast Group Limited is headquartered in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong. DreamEast Group Limited is a subsidiary of SkyOcean Investment Holdings Limited.
